The residence

Adélaïde

The penthouse at SOL Residence — the top floor of the development, opening through full-height glazing onto a 79 m² private terrace with an unobstructed outlook over the Bay of Vlorë. A 2+1 of 115.4 m² (16.2 m² common; 131.6 m² in total) with two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a separate laundry sized for a washer and dryer, and an open living, dining and kitchen that runs the width of the apartment to the terrace. The building is finished and complete — ready to occupy in about two weeks, with finishes still to the owner's choosing. Two hundred metres from the water at Kalaja, Vlorë.

Location & setting

The top floor, above the bay at Vlorë

SOL Residence sits on the hillside at Kalaja, Vlorë, where the Ceraunian coast opens onto the Bay of Vlorë — two hundred metres from the water. The penthouse takes the top floor, its private terrace turned to the sea. A finished residential complex minutes from the beach, the town, and the coast road south into the Riviera.
